quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the Clippers' need for faster pace and better ball security
quotes.excerpt: we got to play faster. Two, we got to take care of the basketball.
quotes.quote: We have been working on it. I thought in the game, a little bit of pressure slowed us down a little bit too, but we got to play faster. Two, we got to take care of the basketball. We had 21 turnovers, I think. And then three, just sharp and quick with our cuts off the ball. We kind of walked through certain things, but we got to do it with pace and with speed, so we got to keep getting better at that as well.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers need to pick up the pace and cut down on turnovers after a sloppy 21 turnover performance. He wants the team to be more sharp and quick with their cuts off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the impact of James Harden's departure on team movement
quotes.excerpt: a lot of movement, ATOs coming off screens, pin-downs, pick-and-picker, see actions.
quotes.quote: A lot of movement, ATOs coming off screens, pin-downs, pick-and-picker, see actions. So it is going to be difficult. And then a guy who is also shot-ready at all times. So when he is on the floor, guys have to stay closer to him. There is more spacing. His movement, he knows how to play the game off the ball, on the ball. So we are going to miss that tremendously, so we just got to figure out ways to do it collectively.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue admits the Clippers will miss James Harden tremendously. He noted that Harden provided unique spacing and movement that the team now has to figure out how to replicate collectively.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on increasing Rui Hachimura's role and assertiveness
quotes.excerpt: we just talked to Rui about being more assertive, being more aggressive.
quotes.quote: We just talked to Rui about being more assertive, being more aggressive, being able to use him different ways than just standing in the corner. You got to be able to post up, come off pin-downs, come off screens, and we are going to play through him a lot. I am just running different things to see what he can do, what he is comfortable doing, and then we will just go from there.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue is looking to expand Rui Hachimura's role beyond the corner. Lue says they are working on getting him more assertive and using him in post ups and off screen actions to play through him more.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Rui Hachimura's defensive versatility and growth
quotes.excerpt: he is picking up all the stuff that Jalen Brunson is doing, and he is understanding it.
quotes.quote: Defense has been great. We were just trying to figure out if we can switch and guard one through four. He is showing he can guard point guards a little bit. We know he can guard fives and centers because he is strong and he is big. So defensively, he is picking up all the stuff that Jalen Brunson is doing, and he is understanding it. So I think we can use him in a lot of different ways.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue is experimenting with Rui Hachimura's defensive versatility. Lue says Hachimura is showing he can guard point guards and centers alike, giving the Clippers more options on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on the team's need for increased intensity
quotes.excerpt: we talked about it in the film session, we got to get after it a little bit.
quotes.quote: We talked about it in the film session, we got to get after it a little bit out here.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann says the Clippers need to increase their intensity after reviewing their recent film session.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on his shooting struggles and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: missing make shots is part of the game, but one thing is I know the work.
quotes.quote: Missing make shots is part of the game, but one thing is I know the work that I put in. I know that my work on pay off this year, so I am not tripping about misses. I am just going to take the shots that are given and be as aggressive as I can and do what I do on the defensive end.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann is not worried about his recent shooting struggles. He says he knows the work he put in will pay off and he is focused on staying aggressive and doing his job on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on the team's energy and lack of cliques
quotes.excerpt: there are no cliques, we all are one.
quotes.quote: We got a whole lot of energy, a whole lot of goofballs. We all play a lot. We love being around each other. We enjoy all the moments that we are together. It is a fun time. When we all on the floor, we all laugh, we all joke. It is not just like there are no cliques, we all are one. So that is the one thing that I like about it. We all are together and if one person joking, we all joking together.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann praises the Clippers team chemistry, noting that there are no cliques in the locker room and the group is full of energy and guys who genuinely enjoy being around each other.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on ignoring external criticism of the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I don't listen to outside noise, I don't care about what other people say about my team.
quotes.quote: I don't listen to outside noise, I don't care about what other people say about my team. I know that the only minds and the only worries that really matter is the ones that is inside the locker room with us. As long as my teammates are comfortable and confident in our game, that is all I am good for.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann says he ignores outside criticism of the Clippers. He believes the only opinions that matter are the ones inside the locker room.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on the benefits of the team's youth and athleticism
quotes.excerpt: just being able to get up and down the floor a whole lot and utilize the athleticism.
quotes.quote: Just being able to get up and down the floor a whole lot and utilize the athleticism that we have, the youth that we have, and just being able to play faster. A lot of guys touching the ball a lot more, a lot of bodies moving a lot more. It is going to be a whole different offense.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann expects a different look for the Clippers offense this year, emphasizing that the team will utilize their youth and athleticism to play faster and get more bodies moving.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on his increased defensive responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: always a little bit more responsibility for me on the defensive end, just to be more vocal.
quotes.quote: Always a little bit more responsibility for me on the defensive end, just to be more vocal, hold myself accountable to be more vocal, be more physical on the defensive end, just assert my presence a lot sooner in the games and not just trying to coast through the first half and then turn it up in the second half. For me personally, I just got to lock in and be more vocal.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann is focused on being more vocal and physical on defense this season. He says he needs to assert his presence early in games rather than waiting until the second half to turn it up.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann on his defensive partnership with Chris Jobs
quotes.excerpt: that was me and Chris Jobs since we came here.
quotes.quote: That was me and Chris Jobs since we came here. That is just, that is just always been our job, just to always be the head of the snake defensively. So we are going to keep, we are going to keep that job running.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann says he and Chris Jobs are committed to their role as the head of the snake for the Clippers defense.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on learning from teammates and coaches
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm learning a lot from my teammates, my coaches.
quotes.quote: I feel like I'm learning a lot from my teammates, my coaches, just adapting to this play style, to the pace of play, to physicality. I feel like obviously having such high-level players on my team and high-level coaches the past two months, I've been learning a lot.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says he is learning a lot from the Clippers veteran players and coaching staff as he adapts to the pace and physicality of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the importance of conditioning and physical play
quotes.excerpt: my body is going to be very important, just being able to hit and play physically.
quotes.quote: My body is going to be very important, just being able to hit and play physically against guys my size. That is going to be very important. Then conditioning too, running a lot up and down at a very fast pace. And yeah, then I feel like just knowing how to play the game the right way, know what we want to do, execute whatever Coach Lue wants us to do and try to make the game easy for my teammates.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says conditioning and physical play are his top priorities as he looks to execute Coach Lue's system and make the game easier for his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on wanting to play against Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I say probably Giannis. Yeah, he's been one of my favorite players to watch growing up.
quotes.quote: I say probably Giannis. Yeah, he's been one of my favorite players to watch growing up, so that would be exciting.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says he is most excited about the prospect of playing against Giannis Antetokounmpo, who he grew up watching.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the mentorship of DJ and BI
quotes.excerpt: DJ and BI, they've been very helpful throughout the whole offseason just helping me adapt.
quotes.quote: I would say probably DJ and BI, they've been very helpful throughout the whole offseason just helping me adapt, teaching me stuff. But honestly all of them, all of the vets like DG, Brad, KD, they've all they've all really been helping me and and all of the the young guys to get better.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown credits the Clippers veterans for their mentorship throughout the offseason, helping him and the other young players adapt to the league.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on playing with confidence
quotes.excerpt: just play hard but play confident. Just be yourself, do whatever the coaches ask.
quotes.quote: I would just say kind of just play hard but play confident. Just be yourself, do whatever the coaches ask, but play confident, play hard and and everything will work out.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says his mindset for the upcoming season is simple, play hard, play confident, and do whatever the coaches ask.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on his role as a five and using his speed
quotes.excerpt: this year playing the five, just kind of using my speed to to my advantage.
quotes.quote: I feel like this year playing the five, just kind of using my speed to to my advantage is going to be very important on both ends of the floor. Kind of trying to be more disruptive on on defense against bigger bigs that that are stronger. And then on offense, just trying to create advantages, whether it's in dribble handoffs, drives, stuff like that is going to be big for me because my advantage is is speed, not not strength.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown plans to use his speed to his advantage while playing the five this season. He says he wants to be more disruptive on defense and create advantages on offense through dribble handoffs and drives.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the camaraderie of the young Clippers players
quotes.excerpt: coming in with two rookies with like Nick and Kian has been great.
quotes.quote: It's been really good. I mean obviously coming in with two rookies with like Nick and Kian has been great just because you have someone that's kind of in the same boat as you. Everybody's learning and and adapting. But I feel like in general, we have a pretty pretty young group of guys, so so it's been very fun being around each other and and getting to compete together.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says the young core of the Clippers is having fun competing together and learning the ropes of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on Tyronn Lue's coaching style
quotes.excerpt: he kind of gets players to do whatever they're best at.
quotes.quote: I would say he like kind of just like, I mean he's a elite coach obviously. I feel like he kind of gets players to do whatever they're best at. Like he kind of knows how to put players in the best position to to make the team better. So I feel like obviously having players like Rui, DG, BI, players like that, he he really knows how to get them in the right position and then players like me or younger guys that are coming in, he kind of knows what we can bring to the table and and how to put us in a position where where we can succeed and try to help help the team out.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown praises Tyronn Lue as an elite coach who knows how to put players in the best position to succeed and maximize their individual strengths.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on Tyronn Lue's guidance and development
quotes.excerpt: he is trying to help me, like improve all the areas that I have to improve on.
quotes.quote: I feel like he is trying to help me, like improve all the areas that I have to improve on so that I can help the team and and be a part of the team and and try to help us win. I feel like he knows there's certain stuff that he wants me to do and he tells me and I I just try to do it to my best ability.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says Tyronn Lue is actively working with him to improve his game so he can contribute to the team's success.
